name: Automatic audio tagging of soundscapes using PANNs in non-overlapping 5s audio segments.

columns.episode_id: half episode number, shown over one run of fMRI data. E.g., s4e07b is the second (b) half of season 4, episode 7.
columns.onset: audio segment onset time in seconds, from the begining of the half episode.
